decision: From 13 May 2027 you'll need: a clear standalone notice, purpose-bound consent with easy withdrawal, reasonable security safeguards, breach notice to affected users and the Board without delay plus a detailed report within 72 hours, grievance resolution within 90 days, erasure after the purpose ends, and verifiable parental consent for under-18s. Build these into products now so they don't need retrofits.
details: Penalties reach Rs 250 crore under the Act (from memory, not re-verified). A Vision IAS blog claims some duties start Nov 2026, contradicting law firms. Verify with a lawyer.

verify.note: Phases confirmed: 13 Nov 2025 notified, consent-manager provisions 13 Nov 2026, substantive duties 13 May 2027. The 90-day outer limit for grievances is confirmed (Legal500). Breach rule is an initial notice without delay plus a detailed report within 72h (KPMG/Mondaq via search). MeitY gazette PDF returned 403. Search budget ran out, so I couldn't check for any 2026 amendment shortening the window.
